title: A Second-Order Maximum-Bound-Preserving and Energy-Stable Exponential Time-Differencing Method for Allen--Cahn-Type Gradient Flows
summary: The energy dissipation law and the maximum bound principle (MBP) are two important physical features of the well-known Allen--Cahn equation. In this paper, we develop and analyze novel second-order linear numerical schemes for a class of Allen--Cahn type gradient flows. Our scheme is based on the generalized scalar auxiliary variable (GSAV) approach and a novel second-order exponential time-differencing Runge--Kutta (ETDRK2) method.
